::: {#exm-estimation-error}
#### Estimation error of a mean height

Continuing @exm-estimate,
suppose the population mean height of students at our school
were actually $\mu = 172$ cm.
Then the estimate $\hat\mu = 175$ cm
would have estimation error:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\erf{\hat\mu}
&= \hat\mu - \mu
&& \text{(definition of estimation error)}\\
&= 175 - 172
&& \text{(substitute the estimate and the estimand)}\\
&= 3 \text{ cm}
\end{aligned}
$$

In practice we never observe an estimation error,
because we do not know the estimand's value;
if we did, we would not need to estimate it.
:::
